jobs.occupation: Business Analyst, NewTech - KPMG Advisory Academy 2027
jobs.description:
How will AI transform the way organizations work? At KPMG NewTech, you won't just discuss that question, you'll help answer it. Working with some of Denmark's largest organizations, you will help design AI-native ways of working through our NewPractice methodology, implement AI solutions, and support adoption across the business. If you are interested in emerging technologies, steep learning curves, and the opportunity to shape the future of work, this is the place to do it.

About the role

As a consultant in NewTech, you will help deliver AI transformation projects from strategy to implementation and adoption. You will support clients in rethinking how work gets done through AI, combining technology, change management, and business value creation.

Using our NewPractice methodology, you will help organizations build AI-native ways of working, working closely with clients, supporting project delivery, and contributing to proposals and new ideas. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, enjoys learning, and is motivated by ownership and impact.

AI is at the core of how we work. You will actively use AI tools in your daily work, helping us deliver projects smarter, develop new methods faster, and demonstrate effective AI adoption in practice.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

• 
Contribute to AI transformation projects end-to-end: scoping, delivery, and adoption.

• 
Work directly with client teams to design AI-native processes using our NewPractice methodology.

• 
Use AI tools regularly in your own work and helping clients and colleagues do the same.

• 
Translate what our technical teams build into something clients understand and want to use.

• 
Support proposals and helping prioritize use cases based on value, feasibility and impact.

• 
Help develop our methods and delivery approach as we scale.

Perks of joining NewTech

At KPMG NewTech, we work at the intersection of business, technology, and implementation. Unlike traditional consultants, we not only advise clients on transformation but also help design, build, and implement solutions alongside them. Our projects combine AI, automation, emerging technologies, and organizational change, giving you the opportunity to work across business and technical disciplines while turning ideas into practical solutions.

Our team brings together consultants, engineers, data scientists, and software developers who collaborate closely and learn from one another. Working in cross-functional teams, you will develop both advisory and technology-related skills while gaining experience from colleagues with diverse backgrounds.

What sets NewTech apart is our focus on consulting. From day one, you will help shape solutions, test technologies, and work directly with clients to promote adoption and value realization. It is an ideal environment for those who want to work with emerging technologies while staying close to real business challenges.

About you, our new team member

You have good analytical skills and enjoy solving business challenges where technology plays a central role. You are motivated by analyzing processes, identifying improvement opportunities, and turning complex problems into actionable solutions. Experience with process mapping, use case development, value assessment, and stakeholder management is an advantage.

You are curious about how AI, automation, and data create business value and are motivated to learn about both the organizational and technical sides of transformation. Most importantly, you are self-motivated, collaborative, and motivated to grow in a fast-evolving field.

More specifically, we are looking for someone who:

• 
Has some background in AI, automation, or digital transformation, whether within strategy, delivery, or change.

• 
Has experience using AI tools in your work or studies, with an interest in developing your AI skills.

• 
Has a structured way of working and the ability to keep projects moving forward.

• 
Is comfortable working in an evolving environment where not everything is defined in advance.

• 
Has a genuine curiosity about AI, its impact on organizations, and emerging trends shaping the business landscape.

• 
Is fluent in English and Danish or another Scandinavian language.

• 
Holds or are expected to complete a relevant master's degree before Autumn 2027.

KPMG Advisory Academy

As part of your development, you will join the KPMG Advisory Academy, a 14-month development program designed to give you a solid foundation for your consulting career. Through a combination of professional training, personal development, networking opportunities, and practical client experience, you will build key consulting skills while expanding your network across KPMG Advisory.

Want to learn more about the KPMG Advisory Academy and how it supports your development from day one? Read more about the Advisory Academy here.

Are you ready to become part of KPMG? Send your application today!

The application deadline is 15 November, but we review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process earlier - so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Interviews are expected to take place in November and December.

All we need from you is your CV, transcript, and a cover letter (a one-page document in which you answer the following three questions). How you choose to respond is entirely up to you - your answers will help us get to know you better and provide a basis for further discussion in a potential interview.

The questions are:

• 
Describe a project where you solved a challenging problem using data, analytics, automation, or AI. What was the problem, how did you approach it, what did you implement, and what did you learn?

• 
Imagine you need to explain the value of using AI‑enabled ways of working with a client who has never used AI before. How would you approach the conversation and help them understand how AI could support their daily work and decision‑making?

• 
Why are you interested in a business analyst role in NewTech at this stage of your career, and what skills or areas are you most excited to develop?

If you have any questions or would like more information, please contact Sebastiam S. Jørgensen sjoergensen@kpmg.com.

Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail to ensure GDPR compliance.

At KPMG, we are committed to developing diverse talents at all levels. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

We can’t wait to hear from you!

jobs.description:

Join Saxo’s Enterprise Identity & Data Security (EIDS) team and help strengthen the bank’s privileged access management capabilities. You will be responsible for implementing, operating, and continuously improving PAM controls that protect privileged accounts, administrative access, and critical systems across Saxo’s technology landscape.

Working closely with infrastructure, cloud, security, and application teams, you will help reduce privileged access risk through modern PAM practices, automation, and Zero Trust principles.

Responsibilities

• Implement and manage privileged access controls across on-premises and cloud environments

• Administer PAM capabilities including credential vaulting, password rotation, session management, and privileged session recording

• Onboard privileged accounts, systems, applications, and service accounts into the PAM platform

• Support adoption of least-privilege, Just-In-Time (JIT), and Zero Trust access models

• Automate PAM processes and integrations using PowerShell and APIs

• Support monitoring, reporting, audits, and access to governance activities

Your profile

You are an experienced cybersecurity professional with a strong background in Privileged Access Management (PAM), Identity & Access Management (IAM), and security engineering. You combine deep technical expertise with a practical, risk-based approach to securing critical systems and privileged access within complex enterprise environments.

• 7-10 years of experience in Privileged Access Management, Identity & Access Management, or Cyber Security Engineering

• Hands-on experience with enterprise PAM solutions

• Strong understanding of privileged access risks, account lifecycle management, and security best practices

• Experience securing Windows, Linux, cloud platforms, databases, and network devices

• Knowledge of Active Directory, Entra ID, and Azure environments

• Experience with automation and scripting, including PowerShell and APIs

• Experience working in regulated environments, preferably within financial services

Certifications & Platforms

You have practical experience working with leading PAM technologies and understand how privileged access controls support a broader security strategy. Experience with multiple platforms is highly valued, particularly in enterprise-scale environments.

• Experience with Delinea Secret Server or other Delinea PAM solutions will be considered a strong advantage

• Experience with CyberArk, BeyondTrust, One Identity, or similar PAM platforms is also highly valued

Personal competencies

You are a structured and proactive professional who thrives on solving complex security challenges. You can effectively collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders and translate business and security requirements into practical solutions.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities

• Structured, proactive, and delivery-focused mindset

• Ability to translate security requirements into practical technical solutions

• Strong collaboration skills and a continuous improvement mindset

jobs.description:

You will work closely with senior stakeholders across Compliance, Risk, Legal and the business, helping translate complex regulatory requirements into practical, scalable and sustainable solutions that support both compliance and business objectives.

• Set the strategic direction for Saxo's Group-Wide Risk Assessment framework, methodology and governance, ensuring it continues to evolve in line with emerging risks and regulatory expectations.

You bring strong leadership experience and deep expertise in financial crime prevention, risk management or compliance. You combine strategic thinking with strong execution capabilities and have successfully led and developed specialist teams in complex environments.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher/Assistant Professor in Citizen Trust and Public Sector Artificial Intelligence
jobs.description:
The research project “TRUST-AI: Citizen Trust in AI Government” invites applications for a position as a Postdoctoral Researcher or an Assistant Professor. The project is directed by Associate Professor Mogens Jin Pedersen (Department of Political Science, Faculty of Social Sciences, the University of Copenhagen) and is funded by the Independent Research Fund Denmark (IRFD).

  The position is a full-time fixed-term appointment for a minimum of 2.25 years (27 months) with potential for extension for a maximum of 3.25 years (39 months). The final contract duration and the specific level of appointment (Postdoc or Assistant Professor) are contingent upon the candidate’s profile and the Department’s specific teaching requirements. While the project secures a minimum of 2.25 years of research-focused employment, any appointment beyond this period—as well as the offer of an Assistant Professor title is subject to a match between the candidate's profile and the Department’s specific teaching needs.

  The starting date is 1 March 2027 (or as soon as possible thereafter).

  The Research Project 
 TRUST-AI is a four-year, IRFD-funded project (6.3 million DKK) dedicated to delivering critical insights into the responsible implementation of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the public sector. The project aims to guide AI transformations that build and secure citizen trust in public services.

  While existing research often focuses on individual-level predictors of trust, TRUST-AI shifts the focus to the AI system itself. We examine how citizen trust is affected by specific AI characteristics—such as accuracy, transparency, and stated purpose—and by particular application modes (such as the distribution of human-AI authority and the specific decision tasks and policy domains to which it is deployed). Furthermore, the project tests concrete strategies for earning citizen trust through targeted information and framing cues.

  Methodologically, the project employs large-scale experimental studies, including survey-embedded and field experiments. Our goal is to provide foundational knowledge that translates into both high-impact publications in top-tier public administration, political science, and general social science journals, and actionable policy recommendations for the public sector.

  The project team consists of the PI, a Co-PI, a Co-I, a Research Assistant, and an international advisory network of leading scholars.

  Job Description
 As a core member of the TRUST-AI team, you will actively contribute to a collaborative research agenda while having the opportunity to develop your own independent research profile.
 Key responsibilities include:

   	
• Developing, designing, coordinating, and implementing advanced survey-experimental studies in collaboration with the project team.  	
• Authoring and co-authoring high-quality research papers for submission to leading international journals. 	
• Presenting findings at international conferences. 	
• Actively participating in the project’s intellectual life and the broader research environment at the Department.   Additional tasks may include contributions to popular dissemination (e.g., reports, op-eds, or talks for public stakeholders). For contracts exceeding the minimum duration (27 months), teaching responsibilities will be included. The specific load and subject areas will be negotiated based on departmental teaching needs and the candidate’s expertise.

  Your Qualifications
 Applicants must hold (or be close to completing) a PhD in Political Science, Public Administration, or a related field. The PhD must be awarded prior to the start date. In addition, selection will be based on the following criteria:

   	
• Research Interest: Demonstrated interest or research experience in attitude formation, public sector digitalization, and/or AI integration. 	
• Methodological Expertise: Strong quantitative skills, specifically in experimental methods, survey design, and causal inference. 	
• Publication Experience: An emerging track record of publications in international scientific journals (commensurate with career stage). 	
• Drive and Collaborative Spirit: The ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a highly collaborative research team. 	
• Communication: Excellent proficiency in spoken and written English.   Familiarity with the Danish public sector and/or Danish language proficiency is considered an advantage but is not a requirement.

  Your Opportunities
 The position offers a range of attractive opportunities for the candidate, including:

   	
• Membership in a vibrant, ambitious, and supportive research team with excellent opportunities for intellectual development and mentoring as part of a high-profile, IRFD-funded project with significant societal impact. 	
• Funding for data collection and conference attendance, as well as opportunities for developing a strong international research network. 	
• Being part of a stimulating and internationally recognized research environment at one of Europe’s leading departments of political science—with flexible working conditions and a supportive workplace culture in the heart of Copenhagen.   The Department of Political Science
 The Department of Political Science at the University of Copenhagen is a top-ranked European department, offering a vibrant, collegial, and pluralist academic working environment. We house roughly 75 faculty members and 25 PhD students. You will be affiliated with the Public Administration and Policy Research Section, which provides a highly relevant and supportive intellectual home for this project.
 For more information on the Department, please consult: https://politicalscience.ku.dk/about/

  Salary and Terms of Employment
 Terms of appointment and salary will be in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC).
 The salary range for postdoctoral positions starts at DKK 39,900/approximately EUR 5,300 + an 18.07 % pension contribution. It is possible to negotiate salary supplements on an annual basis.

  You can find further information about the qualification requirements for postdoctoral positions here.

  Recruitment Process
 Information on the recruitment process at the University of Copenhagen can be found here: Recruitment process.

  An Equal Opportunity Workplace
 The University of Copenhagen is committed in its pursuit of academic excellence to equality of opportunity and to creating an inclusive working environment and therefore encourages all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of personal background, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, ethnicity etc. To learn more about our diverse workplace and our participation in the HRS4R HR Excellence in Research, please visit: HR Excellence in Research.

  International Applicant?
 The University of Copenhagen offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including support before and during your relocation and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information about our services at: For international researchers at the University of Copenhagen.

  Contact Information
 For additional information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Mogens Jin Pedersen at email: mp@ifs.ku.dk.

  For more information about the recruitment process, please contact HR South at hr-soendre@adm.ku.dk. Please refer to ID number: 211-2643/26-2I.

jobs.occupation: Evening Shift Supervisor in Facility Service
jobs.description:
Are you systematic, responsible and good with people? And do you thrive in a role where you work independently and are responsible for ensuring high quality for our customers? 

Then you may be the supervisor we are looking for to join our evening shift in Facility Service. 

As a supervisor, you will play an important role in ensuring high-quality cleaning services for our customers and in following up with the employees carrying out the work. You will work largely on your own and independently, so it is essential that you are able to structure your own working day, maintain an overview and take responsibility for ensuring that tasks are followed through to completion. 

At the same time, you need to be good with people. An important part of the job is following up on employees’ work and providing clear, respectful and constructive feedback, so employees know what is working well and where adjustments may be needed. 

Your responsibilities 

Your primary responsibility is to ensure that our customers receive the quality and service we have agreed with them. Your tasks will include: 

• 
following up on cleaning services at our customers’ premises and ensuring that they meet the agreed service standards 

• 
carrying out quality inspections and recording the results in our systems 

• 
maintaining an ongoing dialogue with employees about the quality of their work 

• 
providing specific and constructive feedback and following up when something needs to be done differently 

• 
training and coaching employees at customer sites 

• 
contributing to the start-up and quality assurance of services for new customers 

• 
maintaining an ongoing dialogue with operations management about quality and follow-up 

• 
responding and reporting when you identify errors, deficiencies or other issues at a customer site 

• 
ensuring that cleaning rooms are kept tidy and that bicycles, carts and other equipment are properly maintained. 

Who are you? 

We place particular emphasis on how you work. 

You are systematic and have a natural sense of structure. As you will often work alone, you must be comfortable prioritising your own tasks and making the necessary decisions along the way. You take ownership and act when you see something that is not as it should be. 

At the same time, you understand that good quality is created together with the employees. You communicate clearly and respectfully and are comfortable having the conversation when something needs to be improved. 

You can give feedback in a way that is clear, respectful and helps the employee move forward. 

In addition, we expect that you: 

• 
are service-minded and customer-focused 

• 
work in a structured and efficient manner 

• 
are solution-oriented and good at maintaining an overview 

• 
have experience in commercial cleaning 

• 
have knowledge of cleaning products, materials and equipment 

• 
have experience training, guiding or managing employees 

• 
are proficient in Danish and English, both written and spoken 

• 
are comfortable cycling, as a bicycle is part of the working day. 

A role with freedom and responsibility 

This is the job for you if you enjoy taking responsibility and do not need someone looking over your shoulder. You will have an independent working day in which your systematic approach and judgement are essential. 

In return, you will become an important part of the quality our customers and employees experience every day. You are the person who notices when something works well and acknowledges it, while also taking responsibility for acting when something can be improved. 

Does this sound like you? We look forward to hearing from you. 

Terms of employment 

The position is full-time and subject to the applicable collective agreement. 

The work takes place in central Copenhagen, in Jeudan’s classic properties. You will cycle or walk around the area. You must be in good physical condition, as the properties also have stairs.

Application deadline
There is no application deadline, as we invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

Questions
If you have any questions, please feel free to contact Operations Manager Gitte Enright on +45 70 10 60 70.

jobs.occupation: Two-year Postdoc position on Spintronic Quantum-inspired Computing
jobs.description:
Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a 2-year Postdoctoral Researcher position within the newly funded QUANTRONIC – Spintronic Pseudo-Qubits for Room-Temperature Quantum Computing project, supported by the Villum Experiment programme of Villum Fonden.

We are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to investigate a new class of spintronic pseudo-qubits (p-qubits) based on spin-orbit torque magnetic tunnel junctions (SOT-MTJs). The project explores whether engineered stochastic spintronic devices can reproduce key computational mechanisms associated with quantum systems - including superposition-like states, probability-amplitude-based interference, and entanglement-like correlations—without relying on fragile quantum coherence or cryogenic operation.

QUANTRONIC is a high-risk, high-gain research project positioned at the intersection of spintronics, probabilistic computing, quantum-inspired computing, nanoelectronics, and integrated circuit design. The central concept is a novel SOT-MTJ architecture designed to represent and manipulate probability amplitudes and to enable synchronization between multiple pseudo-qubits. The project will combine physics-based modelling, device design and fabrication, experimental characterization, and system-level demonstrations.

The successful candidate will work within SDU Microelectronics and collaborate closely with international partners, particularly INL – International Iberian Nanotechnology Laboratory, on the design and fabrication of spintronic devices.

The position is expected to start in February 2027, with the specific starting date to be agreed with the successful candidate.

 

As a Postdoctoral Researcher in QUANTRONIC, your key responsibilities will include:

• 
Develop and refine physics-based compact models of SOT-MTJ-based pseudo-qubits, including stochastic switching and inter-device coupling.

• 
Develop Verilog-A models and integrate them into circuit-level simulation environments such as Cadence.

• 
Investigate the physical requirements for controlling probabilistic states and representing probability amplitudes in spintronic devices.

• 
Collaborate with project partners on the design and fabrication of SOT-MTJ devices and arrays.

• 
Experimentally characterize standalone devices and coupled arrays, including stochastic switching, synchronization, and entanglement-like correlations.

• 
Investigate quantum-inspired gate operations and system-level demonstrations using networks of pseudo-qubits.

• 
Contribute to proof-of-concept demonstrations, including integer factorization and other quantum-inspired computational problems.

• 
Publish research results in high-quality international journals and conferences and contribute to the dissemination of project results.

• 
Collaborate with researchers in spintronics, probabilistic computing, microelectronics, materials science, and quantum information.

 

What we offer

• 
A unique opportunity to work on a high-risk, high-gain research concept exploring a new computational regime between classical probabilistic and quantum computing.

• 
A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing research section with expertise in spintronics, probabilistic computing, neuromorphic computing, analog/digital IC design, and emerging computing architectures.

• 
Access to advanced facilities for electronic design, device characterization, measurement, and system prototyping.

• 
Close collaboration with INL – International Iberian Nanotechnology Laboratory on spintronic device technology and fabrication.

• 
Opportunities to collaborate with national and international researchers in spintronics, quantum-inspired computing, quantum technologies, and nanoelectronics.

• 
An open, international, and collaborative research environment within SDU's Faculty of Engineering, supporting interdisciplinary research across electronics, physics, materials science, and computing.

• 
Strong opportunities for developing an independent research profile in an emerging area of probabilistic and quantum-inspired hardware.

 

What we expect

Applicants should hold a PhD in electronic engineering, electrical engineering, applied physics, nanotechnology, spintronics, or a closely related field.

The ideal candidate should have experience in one or more of the following areas:

• 
Spintronics and magnetic devices, particularly MTJs, STT-MTJs, SOT-MTJs, or related technologies.

• 
Physics-based modelling of nanoscale or magnetic devices.

• 
Verilog-A, SPICE, and Cadence or comparable circuit/device simulation environments.

• 
Experimental characterization of electronic, magnetic, or spintronic devices.

• 
Stochastic or probabilistic computing systems.

Experience in micromagnetic simulation, magnetotransport measurements, nanofabrication, probabilistic computing, or quantum/quantum-inspired computing will be considered a strong advantage.

We are particularly interested in candidates who are enthusiastic about working across traditional disciplinary boundaries and are comfortable combining device physics, modelling, experimentation, and computing concepts.

The successful candidate should be able to work independently while contributing actively to an interdisciplinary and international research team. Excellent written and spoken English and strong communication skills are required.

 

Workplace description 

The successful candidate will join SDU Microelectronics, a dynamic and expanding section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME). The section conducts internationally recognized research in integrated circuits, spintronics, photonics, and neuromorphic computing, and plays a central role in SDU’s ambition to be a national and European hub for semiconductor and chip innovation. 

 

Further information 

For further information about the position, please contact Professor Farshad Moradi (moradi@sdu.dk / email), Head of the SDU Microelectronics section and Associate Professor Hooman Farkhani (farkhani@sdu.dk / email), Deputy Head of SDU Microelectronics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

• 
Motivated application.

• 
Curriculum Vitae. 

• 
Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

• 
Complete list of publications.

• 
Publications most relevant to the position.

• 
Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

• 
A research statement may be included.

• 
References/reference letters may also be included.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 10, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is February 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

jobs.description:
The Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a 2-year position as a postdoctoral researcher within spintronic computing. The position offers an exciting opportunity to advance spintronics through device physics, simulation, fabrication, experimental characterization, and integration of spintronic devices for advanced computing applications.

We are seeking a highly motivated candidate to investigate, design, fabricate, and characterize spintronic devices, with particular emphasis on Anisotropic Magnetoresistance (AMR), Giant Magnetoresistance (GMR), and Tunneling Magneto Resistance (TMR) devices. The work will combine magnetic and spintronic device physics, materials and multilayer structures, device fabrication, electrical measurement, modelling, and data analysis, with the aim of developing reliable spintronic technologies for advanced computing and emerging semiconductor applications.

The research will focus on understanding, controlling, and exploiting thermal fluctuations and stochastic switching in MTJs for physical entropy generation and energy-efficient computing, with particular emphasis on True Random Number Generators (TRNGs) and Stochastic Neural Accelerators (SNAs).

The successful candidate will work on the physics-based design, modelling, simulation, fabrication, and experimental characterization of spintronic devices and their integration into advanced computing systems. The position also includes a role in the Danish Chips Competence Center, where the candidate will contribute to connecting the Danish semiconductor and spintronics ecosystem with relevant EU pilot lines, facilitating collaboration, technology development, prototyping, and access to European semiconductor fabrication capabilities. The candidate will also contribute to preparing and writing research proposals and funding applications related to spintronics, semiconductor technologies, and advanced computing.

As a spintronic postdoc, you are expected to:

Perform atomistic and micromagnetic simulations of s-MTJ structures and magnetization dynamics to investigate switching mechanisms, thermal activation, stochasticity, variability, and operating conditions relevant to TRNG and SNA applications.

jobs.occupation: AI Business Manager, Digital Development
jobs.description:
Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure? If so, CIP Fund Solutions (CIP FS) is looking for an AI Business Manager to join our Digital Development team.

Team

The AI team is a cross-functional team dedicated to embedding AI directly into CIP's business lifecycles and day-to-day operations across the platform and sits within the wider Digital Development team.

Role

The AI Business Manager is responsible for ensuring AI creates measurable business value across CIP's business lifecycles and works directly with lifecycle owners, product teams, delivery teams, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, drive adoption, and embed AI capabilities into day-to-day processes and ways of working.

The AI Business Manager serves as the bridge between business priorities and AI capabilities, ensuring that AI is integrated directly into the Investor, Investment, Fund & Investment Management, and Project lifecycles rather than delivered as standalone technology initiatives. The role is accountable for helping lifecycle teams identify where AI can accelerate outcomes, improve decision-making, increase productivity, and enhance user experiences while ensuring appropriate governance and value realization.

Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:

Lifecycle Partnership and Business Engagement

• 
Partner with lifecycle owners and business stakeholders to understand priorities and strategic objectives, identifying where AI can improve outcomes, efficiency, and decision quality.

• 
Participate in lifecycle planning and roadmap discussions to embed AI initiatives into business plans from the outset, acting as the primary AI partner for assigned lifecycle domains.

AI Opportunity and Use Case Management

• 
Facilitate identification, assessment, and prioritization of AI use cases, maintaining the opportunity pipeline based on business value, feasibility, and strategic alignment.

• 
Develop business cases, value hypotheses, and success metrics, supporting initiatives from ideation and validation through deployment and value realization.

Embedding AI into Business Lifecycles

• 
Work with business and technology teams to integrate AI into core processes, products, and workflows, redesigning ways of working where relevant and driving adoption of AI-powered tools.

• 
Support the evolution of lifecycle operating models to treat AI as a native capability, scaling effective patterns across domains.

Governance and Responsible AI

• 
Ensure AI initiatives comply with governance, security, risk, privacy, and regulatory requirements, coordinating with legal, risk, compliance, and information security stakeholders as needed.

• 
Support lifecycle teams in navigating AI policies and approval processes, promoting responsible AI practices and appropriate human oversight.

Value Realization and Performance Management

• 
Track KPIs for AI adoption, utilization, and business value, measuring realized benefits such as productivity gains, cost savings, and risk reduction.

• 
Provide regular updates to leadership on AI portfolio performance and lifecycle impact.

Change, Communication, and Enablement

• 
Manage efforts for stakeholder engagement, communications, and change management for AI initiatives, supporting training and capability-building across lifecycle teams.

• 
Build and maintain networks of AI champions and subject matter experts, promoting a culture of experimentation and responsible AI usage.

You

You have a relevant educational background within business, data science, technology, or a similar field. In addition, you have a good understanding of business processes, operating models, and digital transformation, and 5+ years of experience working with technology transformation, AI, data, automation, or similar initiatives, with the ability to translate business challenges into practical AI opportunities and outcomes.

We look for the following in a candidate:

• 
Good stakeholder management and communication skills, comfortable translating between business and technology audiences to turn emerging AI capabilities into practical business value.

• 
Experience driving change, adoption, and organizational enablement initiatives.

• 
Ability to manage multiple initiatives and priorities in a dynamic environment.

• 
Curious, business-oriented, and outcome-focused.

• 
Combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and is motivated by delivering measurable impact through technology-enabled change.

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

---

CIP Fund Solutions’ commitment to diversity and inclusion

CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.

CIP Fund Solutions

CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.

For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.
